description: The custom properties (glTF node extras) the engine reads. Keys without the ponko: prefix belong to the game and are not checked.

ponko.description: the same properties without the prefix, as one object

Animation.description: the reflected component Animation, as JSON

body.description: how the collider's body moves (default fixed)

collider.description: a collider made from the node's mesh

collides_with.description: collision groups (0 to 31) the collider touches

collision_layers.description: collision groups (0 to 31) the collider is in

hidden.description: the mesh isn't drawn (a collision or navigation proxy)

layers.description: render layers (0 to 31) the model is on

lod.description: screen heights of a level-of-detail group made of the node's children

navmesh.description: whether the mesh is walkable ground for navigation meshes

prefab.description: a prefab file spawned in the node's place

sensor.description: the collider reports overlaps and blocks nothing

shadows.description: whether the node's light casts shadows

spawn.description: a named spawn point; true names it after the node
